description: Follow a Monity tracker as this key's owner (needs a write-scope key), by its slug or id (as get_tracker and search_network give it): its changes alert them, from every source it has. For a tracker with one source, optionally a personal condition so only matching changes alert them (e.g. {kind: 'BELOW', amount: 150}, or {words: 'only when it is back in stock'}). Same quotas and limits as the app.

condition.description: Only for a tracker with one source

words.description: Instead of kind: the condition in plain words, e.g. "under 150"

name: follow_tracker
title: Follow a tracker
